summary: Companhia Paranaense de Energia (COPEL), a Brazilian electric utility, filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of the sale of its 23.03% stake in Dona Francisca Energética S.A. (DFESA) to Gerdau S.A. The transaction closed on August 6, 2026, after all conditions precedent, including corporate and regulatory approvals, were met. COPEL received R$ 150,719,205.75 in a single installment, including adjustments under the Share Purchase and Sale Agreement. This divestiture aligns with COPEL's portfolio optimization strategy and simplification of corporate structure. No advisors or financial terms beyond the total consideration were disclosed. The deal is closed, so watch for reinvestment of proceeds or further divestitures in COPEL's portfolio.
